description:
Sync this shop's listings with your own catalogue, matched by your externalId: a new externalId creates a listing, a known one updates it in place, and a row's status can mark it sold or hidden.

In mode "full", every active listing whose externalId is missing from this payload is also hidden; listings without an externalId are never touched. When the account may not publish, new rows are refused while edits still apply.

Returns counts of `created`, `updated`, `retired` and `failed` rows; `results`, one per row, with its `external_id`, the listing `id`, the `action` taken and any `error` and `detail`; and `publish_blocked` (its `code` and `message`) when new rows were refused, null otherwise. Not for a one-off post (use create_listing) or new listings without your own ids (use bulk_create_listings).

listings.description: Your catalogue rows, each matched to its listing by externalId. For a known externalId, the fields you leave out keep their current values

categorySlug.description: Category slug: vehicles, rentals, property, moving-sale, furniture-appliances, electronics, fashion-beauty, sports, baby-kids, books-stationery, hobbies-sports, pets, jobs, services, community-events, tickets-travel, food-drink (a job: jobs; a room or flat to let: rentals)

condition.description: The item's condition in words (cut at 60 characters), e.g. "new", "like new" or "used"; ignored for a job. Leave it out when it does not apply

description.description: The listing page's text: what it is, its state, what comes with it. No contact details (phone, e-mail, links); cut at 5,000 characters. Leave it out for no text

district.description: The district or area as free text, e.g. "Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức" (cut at 80 characters). A new listing needs it (else `location_required`)

externalId.description: Your own id (SKU) for the row: how it finds its existing listing, unique within your shop

images.description: Photos as public image URLs, in display order; eno copies them to its storage and uses the first 8. Most categories need 3 of different angles (else `photos_min`), services 1 (else `photo_required`), jobs none. On a new listing, leave it out only for a job

price.description: The asking price in Vietnamese đồng (VND); for a job, its monthly salary in VND

status.description: active, sold or hidden: puts an existing listing on sale, marks it sold, or hides it. Leave it out to keep an existing listing's status; on a new row it is ignored and the row is posted as a new listing

title.description: The headline buyers see: the item and what sets it apart, e.g. "Honda Vision 2022, 8,000 km". No phone number; cut at 140 characters

mode.description: Your listings missing from this payload. partial (when left out): they stay as they are. full: each active one whose externalId you did not send is hidden, so eno mirrors your catalogue; use it only when the whole catalogue fits in one call (200 rows); a bigger one syncs in partial, since separate full calls hide each other's rows

name: sync_catalogue

created.description: Rows that created a new listing

code.description: Why new listings may not be published, as a reason code

message.description: A sentence to show the seller

publish_blocked.description: Set when the account may not publish new listings right now: new rows were refused, edits still applied; null otherwise

results.description: One result per row, in the order sent

items.description: What happened to one catalogue row

action.description: created: a new listing was posted. updated: the existing listing was changed. failed: nothing was changed for this row, see error

detail.description: More about the failure when there is more, e.g. the words to take out of a job post; null otherwise

error.description: Why the row failed, as a reason code or a sentence to show the seller; fix the row and sync it again. null when it succeeded

external_id.description: Your own id for the row; null when the row had none

id.description: The listing the row created or updated; null when a new row failed

retired.description: Listings hidden because a full sync did not include them; 0 in partial mode

updated.description: Rows that updated an existing listing

title: Sync shop catalogue
